fees.source_gate: GET https://api.gateio.ws/api/v4/spot/currency_pairs field fee=0.2 (%) for all universe pairs, queried 2026-09-24
fees.fill_model: All simulated fills are TAKER, walking the real L2 book (HL l2Book / Gate order_book). Maker is NOT assumed because post-only fills are not guaranteed; a maker-fee counterfactual is logged per trade (fee_maker_cf) for comparison only.

rules.cadence: markets polled every poll_seconds + snapshot at hh:00:15 (oracle for funding); funding accrual + rule evaluation hourly at hh:02; benchmarks polled every 24h

TAO.note: HL spot HTAO exists but ~$17.5k/day volume -> Gate used

p1000_pons.note: Variant: v1 + PONS capped at 10% of hedged notional.

oneoff_costs.source_hl_new_account: hyperliquid-docs llms-full.txt: 'New HyperCore accounts require 1 quote token (e.g., 1 USDC...) of fees for the first transaction'
oneoff_costs.source_hl_withdraw: hyperliquid-docs llms-full.txt: 'There is a $1 fee for withdrawing'
oneoff_costs.bridge_quote: LI.FI GET https://li.quest/v1/quote fromChain=SOL fromToken=USDT toChain=1337 (HyperCore) toToken=USDC, fetched at start; reverse quote for cash-out estimate
oneoff_costs.not_modeled: Moving funds to/from Gate for Gate-hedged legs (p1000*): Gate deposit/withdraw fees not public without auth -> NOT charged; flagged in reports.

kamino_usdc.accrual_apy: trailing-24h mean of hourly supplyInterestAPY from /metrics/history (spot value spikes, e.g. 27% at 2026-09-24T00Z)

jitosol.note: Yield-only accrual on USD notional; real JitoSOL also carries SOL price beta (not included).

run_mode: indefinite (no end date; portfolios never permanently deactivated; only rule-based rotation between assets)

log_rotation.when: daily at first loop after local midnight (America/Sao_Paulo)
log_rotation.format: <name>.<YYYY-MM-DD>.gz (gzip, verified line/byte count before truncating original)

portfolios_retired_note: p52 ($52) stopped 2026-09-24 when the paper experiment moved to $1,000; archived in paper/archive/run_52usd_2026-09-24/funding_p52/
